svg.metadata: {"story":"Joshua","act":10,"chapter":"Ch.10 · Choose This Day","scene":"B","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Joshua gathers the people at Shechem and says: choose this day whom you will serve, but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.
